commits.message:
feat: update workflows to use AI credits as primary billing metric

GitHub Copilot billing moved to the AI credits model on June 1, 2026.
This updates all agentic-ops workflows and documentation to reflect
AI credits (AIC, 1 AIC = $0.01 USD) as the primary user-facing billing
metric, replacing the effective-tokens framing.

Changes:
- agentic-token-audit: add ai_credits to RunData schema, audit snapshot
  JSON, rolling summary, chart labels, report template, and observations;
  sort by total_ai_credits; mark effective_tokens as deprecated legacy
- agentic-token-optimizer: capture ai_credits in jq aggregation, sort by
  total_ai_credits, update analysis matrix, issue template, and
  optimization-log schema
- README/aw.yml: update tagline and descriptions to reference AI credit spend
- CHANGELOG: add 0.3.0 entry documenting the billing terminology change

Co-authored-by: mnkiefer <8320933+mnkiefer@users.noreply.github.com>
